name: Berjaya Property Berhad
summary: Berjaya Property Berhad engages in the gaming and lottery management business in Malaysia and internationally. It operates through Toto Betting and Related Activities; Motor Vehicle Dealership; Property Development and Property Investment; Hotels and Resorts; and Club, Recreation and Others segments. It engages in betting operations; leasing of online lottery equipment; manufacturing and distribution of computerised wagering and voting systems; motor vehicle retail; repairs, maintenance, and providing of related aftersales services; development of residential and commercial properties; operation and letting of properties; management and operations of hotels, resorts, and casino; and operatio…
